scope: Corrected identity and architecture-family verification for Parakeet-line distillation and new-model candidates under the no-NVIDIA / no-Nemotron scope. Metadata only: no weights downloaded, no model runs.

corrections.identity: HTTP 401 on the Hugging Face API: not a public repository. It was a search artifact from my own --include list and is not a candidate.
HTTP 401: not a public repository, same artifact.

corrections.correction: 148,923,399 parameters but NOT a distilled student: upstream documents it as a 1.58-bit ternary TDT v3, i.e. an integer-quantized repack. Excluded by the standing integer-quantization rule, not merely gated on a download.

candidates.architecture_family: third-party fine-tune of the NVIDIA 110M CTC line, non-NVIDIA repository
candidates.reason: Only verified non-NVIDIA-originated Parakeet-line model that is a genuine smaller student with a portable export format: 109,305,345 parameters, sentencepiece tokenizer, safetensors weights and a transformers-style config.
candidates.port_path: Requires a new transformers-based ONNX export for ParakeetForCTC and a CTC emission path. This repository has CTC runtimes (gigaam-ctc, wav2vec2, lasr-ctc) but no ParakeetForCTC family and no parakeet-ctc ONNX exporter, so the port is real work rather than configuration.
candidates.must_verify_before_porting: Tokenizer and emission layout: whether the exported graph emits per-frame logits plus a vocabulary mapping compatible with the existing CTC decoding path.

candidates.reason: Genuine non-NVIDIA distillation candidate, but the repository publishes .nemo weights only, so porting means running our own NeMo TDT ONNX export over the existing tools/nemo-tdt-onnx-export path. Parameter count is not published in the metadata record.
627,270,663 parameters, the same size class as Parakeet TDT v3, so it is not a student or size win.
Third-party ONNX export of the stock v3 line. Could replace our own local v3 export; not a new port target.
GGUF is not an executable runtime format here and integer quantization is a separate evidence-gated decision.

no_family_verified_portable_yet: No Parakeet-line model is yet verified portable under the no-NVIDIA / no-Nemotron scope: the two keepers publish no ONNX, so both require our own export before any port claim.
next_step: Start with ctaguchi/parakeet-hf-ctc-110m-en because safetensors plus a transformers config give the shortest export path; verify tokenizer and CTC emission layout before writing the family.
no_authority_used: No weights were downloaded and no model was run for this verification.

new_resolution.method: HTTP range read of the first 2 MB of the .nemo tar; no 2.5 GB download.
new_resolution.parameter_evidence: 2,508,649,755 bytes of float32 weights equals roughly 627M parameters.
new_resolution.reason: It is a full-size 627M Conformer-RNNT, the same architecture and scale as the already-ported Parakeet v3 and Orukeet. The earlier "genuine distillation, future export task" label was unverified and is now disproved; the 2_95_WER name indicates a full-size retrain or fine-tune, not a size reduction.

survey_conclusion.detail: Across 62 surveyed records plus per-candidate verification, no non-NVIDIA Parakeet-line model smaller than 627M exists that this project may port. moondream/parakeet-redux is the only sub-300M record and it is a 1.58-bit ternary repack of TDT v3, excluded by the standing integer-quantization rule rather than by lack of evidence.
survey_conclusion.decision_left_to_user: Whether integer/ternary quantization counts as a permitted path for parakeet-redux is a standing-rule decision, not a technical blocker. If it is permitted, it is a separate evidence-gated port, not a distillation.
